findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: BOTH node passes on revision-aede85a6 returned findings (one major, three minors, one nit; all in the visibility, none in the guards) and are fixed in this revision — joining before redacting was not always stronger (`redactText`'s scheme rule orphans a value when the next element starts with a scheme word, so a standalone `Bearer <token>` element leaked), `(audited)` was claimed for attempts that persist nothing (withheld, or `audit.enabled: false`), the regression test did not pin the notice fix, the new tools test omitted a required option, and the CHANGELOG overstated the redaction. Re-sealing so both node records can match the tree.
